In April 2026 we built an integration with Bongo Cat together with Irox Games, and with Tap Tap Loot, which Irox Games also publishes. We added a tap() function to our game, so a player writes two lines of Python and our farming drone automates the tapping in Bongo Cat while they get on with something else:

while True:
    tap()

The update announcement reached 139,000 unique views and 996 up votes, the best received post we have ever put out: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2060160/view/528750685224702299

That collaboration is still live as a Steam bundle, "The Typer Was Replaced", which pairs our game with Tap Tap Loot: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/72553/The_Typer_Was_Replaced/ If it is useful to you, we would happily bring that bundle into the event, so the sale gets an actual companion crossover on the page rather than just one more entry.

So the connection is functional rather than thematic. Our game is the thing that automates a desktop companion, and it behaves a bit like one in practice: it sits on a second monitor and runs idle in the background while the drone works. Our Steam tags are Programming, Automation, Education, Idler and Logic, and the overlap with the companion and idler audience is exactly why the Bongo Cat collaboration landed so well.

If that is still too far outside your focus, no hard feelings at all, and thanks for putting the event together either way.

Spiriki: Tiny Island is a cozy incremental game where you transform a forgotten island into a peaceful sanctuary.
Care for three baby spirits with light virtual-pet gameplay. Lift them, pet them, and give them little treats! Don’t stress about management or disappointing them if you’re too busy: they are content with you just being here! Focus on one spirit or observe your island from afar, it’s your choice!
Enjoy an easy-to-handle decoration system: choose an item, rotate it as you wish, and place it on your island! No worries, you can always move it later, and if you change your mind, with a simple click of the mouse, sell it! This feature is only available in full screen, but the player can switch at any time between full-screen and windowed mode with just a click.
Our indie team added a few features for comfort: hide the UI to enjoy your scenery fully; choose the volume of the different sounds of the game (the music, the SFX, and the natural ambiance); and choose between five visual and sound ambiances, from day to night, dawn to dusk, and if you enjoy the sound of a soft storm, a rainy ambiance!

To us, the wholesomeness is found in our desire to escape from incremental games centered around automation, productivity, and big numbers. We want Spiriki to be a companion in our players’ daily activities who helps them relax and value their attention.
(Applying for the cozy part) It's cozy, cute and beloved by players :)
